d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ki taiyariyan joron par hain. ranchi ke bajaron men chhath puja ki kharidari ke lie logon ki bhir umar rahi hai. bajar men phal-phul aur puja ki samagri ki dukanen saj chuki hain, lekin is bar mahangaee logon ki jeb par bhari par rahi hai.
Chhath ke bajar men kele ki ek kandi ki kimat karib 1000 rupye tak pahunch gaee hai, jabki ek ketari 50 rupye men bik rahi hai. iske alava puja men istemal hone vale phal aur any samanon ke dam bhi kaphi barhe hue hain.
